map_parts.name: Map: dotted trail + lit gradient trail
map_parts.context: A fork as on the map: unlit branches are round-capped dots (dasharray 0.1 8, 1.6 px, --dash-line). The lit route is a 2.4 px stroke with a gold -> violet-soft gradient (objectBoundingBox x1 0 -> x2 1), drawn on via stroke-dashoffset 1 -> 0 (pathLength 1). Geometry uses the map's own curve recipe: horizontal run, then a cubic with both handles horizontal (C x+43.2 y, x+64.8 y2, x+108 y2 on the desktop map).
